task.notes: Diagnostic K7: a knockout against its wild type, with the other wild-type stages as the only inputs.

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

s2_form_revert.factor: per lineage group with >= 200 cells: mean within-cell panel proportions; per group held by >= 3 other wild-type samples: log(mean + 1e-5) fitted on stage day by least squares, read at the reference's day; t3_decompose.gene_factor of that trend against the reference's group means (weights: the reference's group sizes; eps 1e-5; clip 0.25-4); exponent 0.5

s2_form_revert_grp.factor: per lineage group with >= 200 cells: mean within-cell panel proportions; per group held by >= 3 other wild-type samples: log(mean + 1e-5) fitted on stage day by least squares, read at the reference's day; t3_decompose.gene_factor of that trend against the reference's group means (weights: the reference's group sizes; eps 1e-5; clip 0.25-4); exponent 0.5
